adapter.goal: Map Material spec, Material UI, Compose Material3, and Fret Material3 button facts into the shared component parity fact packet.
source_precedence: Material spec for normative outcomes and token names
Material UI for web DOM and state-class outcomes
Compose Material3 for non-DOM state and motion semantics
Fret ecosystem implementation for current measurable wiring

limitations: This is the first Material adapter slice; it proves shared packet shape and source mapping, not full Material parity.
No upstream browser DOM snapshot is attached yet, so Material UI web geometry is source-referenced but not live-measured.
Fret Material 3 headless goldens exist in Rust tests and should be promoted into bundle/sidecar evidence in the next slice.

facts: Material buttons expose a button activation role with a label-derived accessible name.
Disabled buttons remain non-invokable and must report disabled state.
Focus, hover, and press are interaction states that influence state-layer visuals without becoming core mechanism policy.
Fret Material3 Button sets SemanticsRole::Button through PressableA11y.
Fret Material3 Button disables activation when disabled or when the bound action is unavailable.
The existing headless suite renders enabled and disabled Material buttons with stable test IDs.

checks.expected: Bundle schema2 semantics should expose role=button, label, disabled flag, and invoke/focus action state for enabled and disabled Material buttons.

promotion.reason: The invariant is Material Button recipe semantics; only missing portable semantics fields should be promoted inward.

parts.label: Material 3 Button token-driven text and paint facts

facts: Button height, shape, state-layer opacity, label text style, and container/label colors are token-driven Material outcomes.
Pressed shape and state layer are policy-layer interaction visuals.
Icon and label spacing is a component recipe token, not a core layout mechanism.
Fret Material3 Button resolves container height, padding, shape, text style, and state-layer colors through Material token keys.
Bundle schema2 text_paint tables provide first-class text/paint diagnostics for promotion into future Material parity gates.

checks.expected: Material Button diagnostics should attach bundle schema2 text_paint rows for text prepare, widget measure, and paint widget hotspots when a Material button is captured.

promotion.reason: The first Material adapter needs diagnostics evidence before broad token parity claims.
